contract.provenance: Private WeakMap tracks fresh factory arrays with immutable Agent/kind metadata; no arbitrary-array registrar. Captured allocator references can create fresh lists, so this is factory provenance, not exclusive call-site provenance.
contract.inspection: Lookup rejects foreign Agent/preview/noncanonical storage, reuses getNativeListState, returns original mutable array and copied current entry references plus borrowed Array.prototype.
contract.restoration: Existing createStateCheckpoint nativeLists API only. No replacement storage or generic copier.
contract.privacy: Factory and metadata reader are control support, excluded from capture instrumentation; direct allocator introspection cannot mutate registry or register supplied arrays.

limitations: No general execution owner, private admission before capture expansion, or confinement of future calls/allocations/effects.
